"""Read-only post-rebase validation using the original private task tree."""
import copy,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
base='d2bd73ef48ecad7cf491326c6e366aa09c2a89b9'
task='e59a09b9f939afae28e718f2cca3d53728ffd45b'
remote='1f7d8c76f9634ea1c220f0106574062a95d915cf'
relative='mod_nailong/data/fullsize-files.json'
worktree=ROOT/'runtime/production-sync/low-v7-auto2-revalidated-sync2-20261025-7adf580d30af'
def git(*args,cwd=ROOT):
 r=subprocess.run(['git','-c','gc.auto=0',*args],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
 assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'),r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
 return r.stdout
candidate=git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=worktree).decode().strip()
assert git('rev-parse',candidate+'^').decode().strip()==remote
assert not git('status','--porcelain',cwd=worktree).strip()
assert not (Path(git('rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir',cwd=worktree).decode().strip())/'rebase-merge').exists()
def tree(commit):
 result={}
 for item in git('ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree',commit).split(b'\0'):
  if item:
   meta,name=item.split(b'\t',1);result[name.decode()]=tuple(meta.decode().split())
 return result
bt,ot,rt,nt=[tree(c) for c in [base,task,remote,candidate]]
own={p for p in bt.keys()|ot.keys() if bt.get(p)!=ot.get(p)}
foreign={p for p in bt.keys()|rt.keys() if bt.get(p)!=rt.get(p)}
assert own&foreign=={relative},sorted(own&foreign)
expected=dict(rt)
for p in own-{relative}:
 if p in ot:expected[p]=ot[p]
 else:expected.pop(p,None)
expected[relative]=nt[relative]
assert expected==nt
def pinned(c):return json.loads(git('show',c+':'+relative))
b,o,t=[pinned(c) for c in [base,task,remote]]
assert set(b)==set(o)==set(t)=={'schema','storage','count','original_png_bytes','outputs'}
assert b['schema']==o['schema']==t['schema']=='naiwa-fullsize-git-files-v1'
assert b['storage']==o['storage']==t['storage']
assert set(b['outputs'])<=set(o['outputs']) and set(b['outputs'])<=set(t['outputs'])
missing=object();merged={}
for key in sorted(o['outputs'].keys()|t['outputs'].keys()):
 bv=b['outputs'].get(key,missing);ov=o['outputs'].get(key,missing);tv=t['outputs'].get(key,missing)
 if ov==tv:value=ov
 elif ov==bv:value=tv
 elif tv==bv:value=ov
 else:raise AssertionError('Per-SHA conflict '+key)
 assert value is not missing and value['path']==f'mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize/{key}.png'
 merged[key]=copy.deepcopy(value)
generated={'schema':b['schema'],'storage':b['storage'],'count':len(merged),'original_png_bytes':sum(v['bytes'] for v in merged.values()),'outputs':merged}
assert pinned(candidate)==generated
blob_sizes={}
for item in git('ls-tree','-rlz','--full-tree',candidate,'mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize').split(b'\0'):
 if item:
  meta,name=item.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid,size=meta.decode().split()
  assert mode=='100644' and kind=='blob';blob_sizes[name.decode()]=int(size)
assert all(blob_sizes.get(row['path'])==row['bytes'] for row in merged.values())
previous_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-auto2-rebase-validation.json'
previous=read_json(previous_path)
for row in previous['validated_original_PNGs']:
 assert nt[row['path']]==('100644','blob',row['git_blob'])
validated_jsons=[]
for p in sorted(own):
 if p.endswith('.json') and p in nt:
  json.loads(git('show',candidate+':'+p));validated_jsons.append(p)
git('diff','--check',remote,candidate)
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-auto2-index-conflict.json'
proof=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-v7-auto2-index-rebased-validation.json'
assert not proof.exists()
write_json(proof,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'verified_at_utc':utc_now(),'validated_commit':candidate,'parent_commit':remote,'original_task_commit':task,'original_task_base':base,'original_failure_and_generator_audit':audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'original_failure_audit_sha256':file_sha256(audit),'only_shared_path':relative,'all_other_task_changed_mode_type_blobs_preserved':True,'all_remote_changes_preserved':True,'task_changed_paths':len(own),'remote_changed_paths':len(foreign),'regenerated_index_count':len(merged),'regenerated_index_original_png_bytes':generated['original_png_bytes'],'all_index_entries_have_correct_ordinary_blob_sizes':True,'own15_PNGs_identical_to_previous_actual_full_byte_validation':True,'previous15_byte_validation':previous,'previous15_byte_validation_sha256':file_sha256(previous_path),'validated_task_JSON_paths':validated_jsons,'isolated_worktree_clean':True,'local_validation_error_boundary':'The earlier generator completed its isolated rebase, then a read-only assertion used the already-rebased7adf tree against d2bd and counted prior remote work as own. This validator uses original e59 against d2bd; no rebase/image request is repeated. Initial sparse git-add failure and original conflict bytes remain in the prior audit.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'scope':'Local full tree, JSON and index blob-size validation. Reuses prior actual full-byte checks via unchanged Git blob identities; no fresh remote download, primary index/workfile/ref mutation or publication claim.'})
print(json.dumps({'proof':proof.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(proof),'candidate':candidate,'parent':remote,'index_count':len(merged),'own_changed_paths':len(own),'foreign_changed_paths':len(foreign),'validated_jsons':len(validated_jsons),'own_PNGs':len(previous['validated_original_PNGs']),'published':False}))
